[CORE-587 - [SCF] Migrate to multi-channel funnel summary widget](https://linear.app/klaviyo/issue/CORE-587) # Description Backend pre-migration logic for Funnel Summary Chart widget. In the future, we will replace all Email,SMS,Push funnel summary widgets with a single multi-channeled widget. This PR uses a feature flag to control what charts are visible, so we can proceed with the migration ### Changes Overview - `src/learning/app/custom_analytics/dashboard_service.py` - check Statsig gate `reporting_enable_multi_channel_funnel_widget` - add `get_visible_widget_count` service method returning `max` visible count across gate states for the frontend dashboard-load check - `src/learning/app/custom_analytics/views/performance_dashboards.py` - add endpoint `visible_widget_count` action on `WidgetViewSet` mapped to `GET /ajax/performance-dashboard/{pk}/visible-widget-count` - `src/learning/_pattern_owners_generated.py` - regenerated to register the new `visible-widget-count` URL pattern under the `reporting` owner - `tests/custom_analytics/test_dashboard_service.py` - `tests/custom_analytics/views/test_performance_dashboards.py` # Manual Test Plan [Testing Plan GDoc](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1OtP7GorEQPq4utGIOTd66shvlq66OWA72cmLuWllw8s/edit?tab=t.ghx09rxseaho#heading=h.ypssrpvigah4) - validate adding widgets with gate on/off locally - validate adding widgets with gate on/off in webserver

Checklist

 Authors and Reviewers, please ensure the following: ## General - [X] This PR has fewer than 500 lines of code changed - [X] This PR does not contain a mix of functional and non-functional changes - [X] If the reviewer isn't entirely familiar with the context of the change, an SME has been tagged ## Tests - [X] Each functional change has corresponding test cases that have been added/modified - [X] Edge cases have been considered and tested - [X] Mocked data makes sense with what is being tested # Risk Impact Ensure that these changes are not going to cause any issues in production. Consider the following: - What are the downstream impacts of this change? Are there any datastore concerns? => **Low. The Statsig gate is OFF by default in every environment, so visibility behavior is unchanged at merge time. The migration command is dry-run by default and idempotent; it only adds rows for dashboards that don't already have a BY_CHANNEL funnel widget. Datastore impact is bounded by the count of dashboards with at least one per-channel funnel widget; insertion happens via `create_widget` (existing path) and is keyset-paginated.** - Are there any performance implications? => **One additional Statsig gate check per `get_widgets` / `refresh_dashboard_if_old` / `create_widget` / `trigger_dashboard_update_task` call. The gate evaluator is in-process and short-circuits on error. The new `visible_widget_count` endpoint runs the same `get_widgets` query already used by dashboard load. The migration command uses keyset pagination (`performance_dashboard_id__gt=last_id`) to avoid full-table scans on the 37M-row Widget table.** - Are there environment-specific flags that would lead to behavioral differences between runtimes/environments? => **Yes by design — `reporting_enable_multi_channel_funnel_widget` controls visibility per-company via Statsig. Default is OFF everywhere; ramped per the rollout plan in the Linear ticket.** - Is this change forward compatible (with data structures produced by previous versions)? => **Yes. The legacy per-channel `FUNNEL_SUMMARY/{EMAIL,SMS,PUSH}` rows remain unchanged in the DB and continue to be served when the gate is OFF. The new BY_CHANNEL row is additive.** - Is this change backwards compatible if a revert is needed? => **Yes. Rollback = disable the Statsig gate; legacy rows immediately reappear. Any BY_CHANNEL rows added by the migration are left in the DB (hidden when gate is OFF) — no code revert required.** - How will you monitor the change? => **Sentry for exceptions in `PerformanceDashboardService` (gate-check failures already log + fail closed). Datadog for the celery `process_funnel_summary_by_channel` task latency / queue depth. Migration command logs per-batch progress + final tally to stdout. During ramp: dashboard-load p95, widget render error rate, and a canary alert on dashboards rendering zero funnel widgets.** # Deploy Plan Everywhere (excluding the hosts that are not part of `qw-ip`) ```sh # Run these commands, replacing the placeholder with the built artifact ID from Jenkins klaviyocli deploy app deploy PASTE_THE_ARTIFACT_ID_HERE webservers klaviyocli deploy app deploy PASTE_THE_ARTIFACT_ID_HERE qw-ip ``` ______________________________________________________________________ - [Author Guidelines](https://klaviyo.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/EN/pages/2917630292/How+to+Submit+Pull+Requests) - [Reviewer Guidelines](https://klaviyo.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/EN/pages/2921070779/How+to+Review+Code) - Feedback on this template, reach out to [#code-review-wrkgrp](https://klaviyo.enterprise.slack.com/archives/C07F4SFQ3A7)
